subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de multiplicação e divisão com números naturais e com números racionais cuja representação decimal é finita (com multiplicador natural e divisor natural e diferente de zero), utilizando estratégias diversas, como cálculo por estimativa, cálculo mental e algoritmos.

components.description_pt: Estimar produtos e quocientes de números naturais usando estratégias de cálculo mental
components.description_en: Estimate products and quotients of natural numbers using mental computation strategies
components.cc_component_description: Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de multiplicação com números racionais decimais finitos usando algoritmos
components.description_en: Solve multiplication problems with terminating decimal rational numbers using algorithms

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de divisão com números racionais decimais finitos com divisor número natural
components.description_en: Solve division problems with terminating decimal rational numbers using a natural number divisor

components.description_pt: Compor problemas que exigem multiplicação ou divisão de números decimais finitos
components.description_en: Compose word problems requiring multiplication or division of terminating decimal numbers
components.cc_component_description: Use the structure of the base-ten system to explain multiplication and division of decimals

cc_matches.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division and of fractions to multiply and divide rational numbers.

Solve multi-step real-life and mathematical problems posed with positive and negative rational numbers in any form (whole numbers, fractions, and decimals), using tools strategically. Apply properties of operations to calculate with numbers in any form; convert between forms as appropriate; and assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies. *For example: If a woman making $25 an hour gets a 10% raise, she will make an additional $\frac{1}{10}$ of her salary an hour, or $2.50, for a new salary of $27.50. If you want to place a towel bar $9\frac{3}{4}$ inches long in the center of a door that is $27\frac{1}{2}$ inches wide, you will need to place the bar about 9 inches from each edge; this estimate can be used as a check on the exact computation.*
Look for and make use of structure.
